newsitem.title: USA: Maine Senate nominates Lawrence as president.
newsitem.headline: Maine Senate nominates Lawrence as president.

text.p: The Maine Senate Democratic caucus unanimously nominated Senator Mark Lawrence, D-Kittery, as the next Senate president.
And with 19 of the 35 seats, he is assured election to the state's second highest post.

Under the state constitution, the senate president is first in line should anything happen to the governor. Lawrence told reporters he had not thought about that responsibility and says he hopes Governor Angus King stays healthy. Lawrence says he looks forward to serving as the leader of the Senate.
Democrats have also elected Senator Chellie Pingree of Knox County as majority leader.
